summary.text: Mike Colvin is a Democratic member of the North Carolina House of Representatives who has represented District 42 since January 2025 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
He works in funeral services and as a political advisor and strategist.

paragraphs.text: Mike Colvin was born in Fayetteville, North Carolina, and earned a bachelor's degree from Duke University.
His career experience includes work as a funeral service professional and political advisor and strategist, and as of 2024 he was affiliated with Simon Temple AME Zion Church.
Colvin assumed office on January 1, 2025, succeeding Marvin Lucas Jr.
The Democratic primary for his seat on March 3, 2026, was canceled.
